div.head: II Cn 73a
div.ab: ⁊ gif heo binnan geares fæce wer geceose, þonne þolige heo þære morgengyfe ⁊ ealra þæra æhta, þe heo þurh ærran wer hæfde; ⁊ fon þa nehstan frynd to ðam landan ⁊ to þan æhtan, þe heo ær hæfde.
⁊ gif heo binnan geares fæce wer geceose, þonne þolige hyo þare morgangyfe ⁊ ealra þara ehta, þeo heo þurh erran wer hæfde; ⁊ fon þa nihstan frind to þam lande ⁊ to þan ehtan, þe heo ǽr hafde.

Et si intra unius anni spatium maritum seligat, perdat morgangyfam suam et omnem pecuniam, quam ex priori marito habebat; et manus iniciant proximi amici eius ad terram et pecuniam, quam ante habebat.

⁊ gyf heo ðonne binnon ðæs geares fæce wer geceose, ðonne ðolie heo ðære morgengeafe ⁊ ealre [þære] æhtan ðe he[o þurh þone ærran were heafde, ⁊ fon þa nyxtan frynd to þam lande ⁊ to þam æhte þæt heo ær hæfde.

And if then, within the space of the year, she chooses a husband, she shall lose her morning-gift and all the property which she had from her first husband, and his nearest relatives shall take the land and the property which she had held.

Wenn sie aber (dann B) innerhalb der Frist eines (des B) Jahres einen Gatten wählt, dann verliere sie jene Morgengabe und alle jene Güter, die sie durch den früheren Mann erhalten hat; und es mögen die nächsten Blutsfreunde [des letzteren] zu dem Lande (den Landgütern G) und zu der Habe greifen, die sie bisher besessen hat.

But if she (then, B) chooses a husband within the space of a (the, B) year, then let her lose that morning-gift and all those goods which she received through the former husband; and let the nearest kinsmen [of the latter] take possession of the land (the landed estates, G) and the property which she has held until now.
div.note: Liebermann compares A's ‘þeo’ with I Cn 3 ‘beo’.
